verdict.rationale: There is no explicit no-training-on-user-data policy documented for the hosted Supermemory service; the only relevant signal is that self-hosting keeps data entirely on your own hardware ('your data never leaves the building'), which indirectly prevents any vendor-side use for training. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that hosted/cloud data is never used to train models, a documented opt-out/data-processing agreement, and independent confirmation of this policy.
